summary: Afya Limited disclosed a merger agreement dated September 23, 2026, under which Afya will merge into Brazilian peer YDUQS Participações S.A., with Afya shareholders receiving newly issued YDUQS common shares per an exchange ratio and YDUQS surviving as the Combined Company listed on B3's Novo Mercado. The transaction is structured as a share-for-share combination, with Afya ceasing to exist as a separate Cayman entity and delisting from Nasdaq. Specific exchange ratio, implied value, premium and expected close were not stated in the excerpt. The closing risk-arb angle centers on ratio disclosure, regulatory and shareholder approvals, and any collar or termination provisions.
